work_items.title: 25-Species Appearance Choice Registry + Constraint Model
work_items.completion_gate: Machine-readable choice registry covers all 25 governed Species/Form profiles with stable IDs, provenance, semantic classification, eligibility, explicit unknown/unavailable handling, and executable dependency/constraint rules; deterministic validation, exact-head hosted CI, PR and signed/verified merge evidence required.

work_items.title: Preset, Randomization and Lock Libraries
work_items.completion_gate: Deterministic eligible pools, weighting/coherence rules, seed/lock behavior and portable synthetic reference presets cover all governed Species and special profile cases with validation and merge evidence.

work_items.title: Pixel-Art Asset Production Standard
work_items.completion_gate: Production specification fixes semantic asset metadata, canvas/view classes, anchors, masks, palette zones/ramps, topology templates, packaging and acceptance criteria without moving renderer metadata into Character truth.

work_items.title: Asset Manifest and Coverage Analyzer Contract
work_items.completion_gate: Versioned asset registry and deterministic coverage model report supported/partial/unsupported/unknown coverage without invalidating Character state or leaking hidden information.

work_items.title: Deterministic Appearance Compiler / Reference Engine
work_items.completion_gate: Repository-side reference engine emits deterministic semantic render-plan JSON from authorized appearance/biology/renderer/permission inputs with explicit diagnostics/fallback and passing deterministic tests.

work_items.title: Wardrobe and Equipment-Fit Compatibility Catalog
work_items.completion_gate: Topology-aware presentation wardrobe and actual-equipment visual fit catalog covers governed morphology classes without implying ownership/mechanics or silently warping unsupported assets.

work_items.title: Full Appearance Studio Screen and State Specification
work_items.completion_gate: Implementation-grade screen/state/control/responsive/accessibility/recovery specification is traceable to the choice/constraint registry and existing PPIA-06 control surface.

work_items.title: Portrait, Token and Export Production Contract
work_items.completion_gate: Versioned portrait/token/export framing, derivative identity, permission filtering, invalidation/regeneration and downstream handoff behavior are deterministic and validated.

work_items.title: Appearance Versioning and Migration Engine Contract
work_items.completion_gate: Schema/option/asset-pack/renderer/preset migration behavior is deterministic, explicitly classifies recoverability and forbids silent substitution.

work_items.title: Accessibility Description Grammar
work_items.completion_gate: Structured nonvisual appearance descriptions and change announcements cover topology, surface, coloration, distinguishing features, wardrobe/equipment projection and renderer support while preserving permission filtering.

work_items.title: Expanded Generated QA and Coverage Corpus
work_items.completion_gate: Large deterministic synthetic/noncanonical regression corpus covers Species/topology/forms/transitions/randomization/hidden state/renderer gaps/equipment fit/migration/mobile/keyboard/accessibility with traceable expected results.

work_items.title: Integrated Production Handoff and Completion Gate
work_items.completion_gate: CAPP-01 through CAPP-11 integrate into one validated implementation handoff with zero unintended orphaned coverage, exact upstream authority traceability, exact-head hosted CI, completion report, PR and signed/verified merge evidence.
